output.explanation: The warehouse holds only historical actuals (2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) and has no forecast table, forecast model, or forecasting method. A Q1 2026 forecast would require me to choose an assumption (for example, Q1 2025 actuals times a growth rate, or a trailing run-rate), and the data dictionary does not define one. I can't produce a forecast from these tables without that choice. Options: (1) I can query Q1 2025 net revenue from completed orders as a baseline, or (2) if you specify a method, such as a growth rate applied to Q1 2025 or the average of recent quarters, I can compute it from completed-order net revenue. Note that 2025 list prices were 4 percent higher, which a forecast should account for.
